core.body_comparison_method: Full function bodies parsed and normalized through identical rustfmt edition 2024 skip_children=true. String contents are retained. Only previously documented owner references and typed document constants are substituted.

mechanical_changes: Original private helper visibility permits sibling action files
InlineField fields visible only in the parent values module
Capture registry references passed to actions without cloning or allocation changes
Original Mod clone order retained, actions receive references to the same captured clone
Original bool modes separately registered, original branches retained verbatim
Read-only bindings lose mut only, unused name binding retains its original unwrap as _name
Unconditional update trace assignment directly initializes the same result
Ownership references resolve to the same env::runtime_ownership module
Public logical module names and API signatures retained
Existing fixture modules moved intact, not executed

updaterController.note: Inlining normalizes extracted call boundaries. No retry, state, message, deadline or poll interval was changed.

frontend.method: Prettier TypeScript AST. Function bodies compared after removing positions and TypeScript type annotations. Formatter normalizes JSX whitespace.

notificationsDiagnosticsRuntimeAssets.method: Rust function body token comparison, with explicit config API/document owner migrations and borrowed metadata adapters normalized. Comments and whitespace excluded, string literals preserved. Optional formatter trailing commas excluded. The five intentionally extracted methods are additionally compared after precise helper inlining.

checks.runtime_network_statics: Moved once into transport, Atomic orderings and initializers preserved. is_server() is supplied lazily through FnOnce and evaluated in the same branch.
checks.asset_parser_local_lifetimes: Helper-local GameFiles contains only PathBufs, metadata contains no open file handle. Returned GameSchema owns its maps, paths and strings. Startup lock lease stays in caller lexical scope.

preserved_hotkeys.world_editor: F1–F8, configured toggle key with F2 default
preserved_hotkeys.debug_console: configured toggle key with F10 default

build_review.accepted_build_intermediate_change: Native and proxy DLLs are staged in build/x64 immediately after the corresponding build, final release package inputs identical.
